description: §66.3 rule 7: `<label=(@user.name)/>` — a member path is not in §66.3 rule 5's inferable set, so the unannotated own value is E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE (a hard error, never `unknown`); writing `label:string=` is the fix.
rationale: §66.3 rule 7: "An own value written without `:T` whose initializer is a non-literal outside the set is a compile error … E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE"; rule 5 lists the set (a member path is named outside it). ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §8 rulings 3 and 5).

codes: severity:code 'E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE' did not fire (expected severity error)
